words.example: Don't waste water when you shower.

words.example: We ate dinner, and after that, we watched a movie.

words.example: We went to the cinema and ate afterwards.
words.example_fa: به سینما رفتیم و بعداً غذا خوردیم.

words.example: He leaned his bike against the wall.
words.example_fa: دوچرخه‌اش را به دیوار تکیه داد.

words.example: I haven't seen you for ages!
words.example_fa: خیلی وقت است که تو را ندیده‌ام!

words.meaning: a very long time in the past
words.example: I visited that city ages ago.
words.example_fa: خیلی وقت پیش از آن شهر دیدن کردم.

words.meaning: to share the same idea or belief
words.example: We both agree on the plan.
words.example_fa: هر دوی ما با این برنامه موافق هستیم.
